text:
OncallBot: PAGER: streaming flow anomalies detected in eu-west-1. p99 latency spike for /v1/stream (SLO: 250ms p99) — current p99 1.8s, p95 320ms. Auto-mitigation kicked: route-fallback disabled. Paging oncall.
Alex: seeing same on grafana, spike started ~14:23 UTC. looks like chunk emit gaps ~300-700ms between some frames.
Maria: any customer reports? CS_Liaison, can you check top customers on eu-west-1? :ear:
CS_Liaison: Quick look — 3 paying customers reporting livestream stalls; highest impact on account acme-inc (high QPS). They're seeing repeated reconnects.
Jyoti: logs show proxy upstream write timeouts to runtime-01 and runtime-03. error snippet:
```
ERROR write timeout to upstream: writev: timed out after 1.2s
stream_session_id=abc123
```
InfraSRE: proxy (edge-proxy-v2) recently deployed keepalive tweak, but timeouts still default 1s. I can bump to 3s if that helps while we investigate.
Sam: before changing timeouts, can we confirm root cause — is this client backpressure, runtime CPU, or network spikes? cpu on runtime-01 is stable ~60%.
Alex: also seeing connection-level retransmits on proxy -> runtime path, TCP RTO increase. suspect intermittent packet loss between proxy and runtime pool.
Jyoti: telemetry shows KV cache pressure on runtime-03 (evictions) — that could cause longer tokenization/first-chunk latency for warm sessions.
Maria: mitigation plan options:
 - short-term: bump proxy write timeout to 3s + enable keepalive probes to prevent premature closes
 - mid-term: divert new streams to eu-central-1 for acme-inc via routing override
 - fallback: offer non-streaming responses for affected customers (batch responses)
InfraSRE: I'll roll timeout change now with a 2-minute watch. will also enable extra logs for write latency.
Alex: +1 for routing override for top affected customers — reduces blast radius.
CS_Liaison: telling acme-inc we're investigating and offering temporary non-stream mode. they're open to failover.
Jyoti: adding a quick patch to runtime to avoid KV compaction during high QPS — will push a config flag that reduces eviction aggressiveness.
Sam: note: if this is network-level, timeout bump only masks issue; but it's acceptable as short-term.
InfraSRE: timeout bump deployed to edge-proxy-v2 eu-west-1 (canary nodes first). Monitoring: p99 dropped from 1.8s -> 900ms on canary after 30s.
Alex: good. can we get p95/p99 graphs and also capture one example SSE stream trace? need headers + chunk timestamps.
Maria: grabbing a trace now and posting.
Maria: trace snippet (timestamps relative ms):
```
> chunk 1: 0ms
> chunk 2: 420ms
> chunk 3: 980ms  <-- big gap
```
Jyoti: that gap correlates with runtime-03 GC spike and an upstream write retry on proxy.
InfraSRE: canary looks promising; rolling to remaining nodes. will escalate to neteng if packet loss persists.
Alex: handoff plan: InfraSRE continues rollout & watch for 30m, Jyoti to follow up on KV/GC tuning, Sam to coordinate perf regression tests, Maria/CS_Liaison to update impacted customers. If p99 > 500ms after 30m, escalate to on-call tier-2 network.
CS_Liaison: acknowledged, I'll keep customers updated every 20 minutes.
OncallBot: NOTE: handoff to next oncall at 5312345710. Paging @InfraSRE for continued watch. :rotating_light:
InfraSRE: taking over monitoring. will post final postmortem stub in #postmortems after we stabilize.
